//go:build upgradeseed

package internal

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// TestUpgradeSeed creates a database at $UPGRADE_SEED_DB with the module's own
// Init and ingest/merge code (the schema and rows of the checked-out tag) and
// writes the equivalent of `sqlite3 <db> .schema` to $UPGRADE_SEED_SCHEMA.
// It stands in for scripts/upgrade-fixtures/snapshot.sh where the sqlite3 CLI
// is not installed. See README.md in this directory.
func TestUpgradeSeed(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Getenv("UPGRADE_SEED_DB")
	if path == "" {
		t.Skip("UPGRADE_SEED_DB not set")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	m := NewModule(Config{DBPath: path, GRPCAddr: "127.0.0.1:0", HTTPAddr: "127.0.0.1:0"})
	if err := m.Init(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	native := func(user, name, ext, typ string) SessionEvent {
		return SessionEvent{
			EventType: typ, SourceModule: "media-ui", ServerType: "native", ServerID: "muxcore-native",
			ExternalSessionID: "native:default:" + user + ":" + ext, UserID: user, UserName: name,
			ItemID: "item-" + ext, MuxcoreID: "mc-" + ext, Title: "Title " + ext,
			IPAddress: "10.1.2.3", Device: "Pixel 9", Player: "media-ui", Platform: "Android",
			GeoCountry: "NL", GeoCity: "Amsterdam", PositionSeconds: 600, DurationSeconds: 7200,
		}
	}
	server := func(serverID, user, name, ext string) SessionEvent {
		return SessionEvent{
			EventType: "playback.started", SourceModule: serverID, ServerType: "jellyfin", ServerID: serverID,
			ExternalSessionID: serverID + ":" + ext, UserID: user, UserName: name,
			ItemID: "item-" + ext, Title: "Title " + ext, IPAddress: "192.168.0.9", Device: "Living room TV",
		}
	}
	ingest := func(ev SessionEvent) {
		if _, _, err := m.ingestSessionEvent(ctx, ev); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("seed ingest %s/%s: %v", ev.ServerID, ev.UserID, err)
		}
	}
	ingest(native("u-victim", "Victoria", "s1", "playback.started"))
	ingest(native("u-victim", "Victoria", "s2", "playback.stopped"))
	ingest(native("u-bystander", "Barry", "s1", "playback.started"))
	ingest(server("jellyfin-main", "jf-victim", "vicky", "a"))
	if _, err := m.mergeUserIdentities(ctx, "jf-victim", "vicky", "u-victim", "Victoria"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ingest(server("jellyfin-other", "u-victim", "Somebody Else", "c"))
	ingest(server("jellyfin-main", "jf-solo", "Solo", "d"))
	_ = m.Stop(ctx)

	db, err := sql.Open("sqlite", path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = db.Close() }()
	for _, stmt := range []string{`PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)`, `PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE`, `PRAGMA page_size=1024`, `VACUUM`} {
		if _, err := db.ExecContext(ctx, stmt); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", stmt, err)
		}
	}
	if out := os.Getenv("UPGRADE_SEED_SCHEMA"); out != "" {
		rows, err := db.QueryContext(ctx, `SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE sql IS NOT NULL AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY rowid`)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		defer func() { _ = rows.Close() }()
		var b strings.Builder
		for rows.Next() {
			var s string
			if err := rows.Scan(&s); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			b.WriteString(s + ";\n")
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(out, []byte(b.String()), 0o600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}
